items.title: Stanley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: compromising his world was rather a sign of defeat to my mind

ctx.x: You know? Like Miles was a perfect example. As soon as he had people with him, he was off somewhere else.

And then I mean to more or less end up with compromising his world was rather a sign of defeat to my mind. I mean that was a matter of money you could say, but I don’t think it was purely money with him, I think it was kind of desperation.
